name: agentic-rag
title: Let the model decide when to search, within a retrieval budget

comparison.purpose: The model chooses between searching sample summaries of Lilian Weng's posts and answering directly. Retrieved passages are graded, and a search that finds nothing relevant leads to a rewritten question and another turn for the model. In LangGraph, only recursion_limit stops a model that keeps calling the retriever. Here a guard rejects RETRIEVE once MAX_RETRIEVALS is spent, so the model has to answer, and that forced answer ends in a failed state marked as unverified.

starters.label: On-corpus — retrieves, grades relevant, answers from the posts

input.question: What does Lilian Weng say about the types of agent memory?

starters.label: Off-corpus — search finds nothing, so the question is rewritten
